propositions: pytest-xdist worker crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' on Python 3.11 when running test_matching_guard_is_accepted, landing randomly on one of four matrix shards
asyncio.wait_for on Python 3.11 consumes external cancellation when child completes in same event-loop turn, leaving worker task parked at queue.get() with cancelling() == 1
worker task ignores lifespan shutdown cancellation and returns to queue.get() instead of exiting, causing pytest-timeout to kill worker process
defect is Python 3.11-specific and does not occur on Python 3.12+, making failure CI-only and timing/load-dependent
fix replaces asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout) with async with asyncio.timeout(): await asyncio.to_thread(...) to restore correct cancellation semantics
